input.summary: Limit HDI's inspection right to once per 12 months, off-site copies, confidentiality, no system access
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.4 already gives 30 days' notice, business hours and HDI's cost, which we accept; we have added an annual frequency limit, a confidentiality obligation and confirmation that no access to our systems is granted, in line with our audit position.

ops.oldText: The fees incurred by HDI in connection with the inspection shall be borne by HDI.
ops.newText: Such inspection may be conducted no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, shall be limited to records reasonably related to the calculation of payments, shall be subject to the confidentiality obligations of Section 8, and shall not include access to the Company's systems or networks. The fees incurred by HDI in connection with the inspection shall be borne by HDI unless the inspection reveals an underpayment exceeding five percent (5%).

input.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees and disapply it on HDI default
input.comment: [Playbook] The Termination Payment formula in Section 4.2(a) is an uncapped penalty on us tied to our own sales, which we cannot accept. We have replaced it with our fallback: an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees, and no payment where we terminate for HDI's failure to perform.

ops.oldText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the amount of which shall not exceed the aggregate payments made by the Company to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months immediately preceding the Termination Date. The Termination Payment shall be the sole amount payable by the Company in connection with termination, and no Termination Payment shall be due where the Company terminates under Section 1.6, for HDI's material breach, or by electing not to renew at the end of a term.
